caption:
US inflation (PCE) for August came in at 3.4% vs 3.7% expected. Core: 3.0% vs 3.3%.
Pero part of the drop came from the BEA changing how it measures some service prices, retroactive to 2021.
Markets cut their bets on an October Fed hike. The fine print still matters.

Education only. Not financial advice.
